opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: Trust contributes 100% of the Fellow's total salary costs up to a maximum of £56,000 in year one, then 50% up to £28,000 in years two and three, with the balance from the host university; up to £6,000 per annum in research expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers with a doctorate who have not yet held a full-time permanent academic post; tenable at UK universities with research degree awarding powers; ~145 fellowships available in 2027
opportunities.summary: Fellowships for early career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable work over 3 years, with the aim of leading to a more permanent position.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers based at UK universities or institutions of higher education, and (on a trial basis) eligible UK independent research institutes; applicants must be employed by the eligible institution
opportunities.summary: Two-stage scheme (outline then detailed) funding innovative and original research projects of up to 5 years. The outline stage is paused (to reopen autumn 2026); detailed applications from invited applicants close 1 September 2026.

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK institutions to invite an eminent senior professor from overseas; applications made by a member of academic staff at a UK university with research degree awarding powers; some specialist arts institutions eligible
opportunities.summary: Funds UK institutions to invite an eminent senior professor from overseas (3-12 months) to bring novel expertise and enhance skills and knowledge in an underrepresented area of research.

opportunities.title: Major Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Replacement salary costs for the duration of the Fellowship, plus research expenses up to £6,000 per year

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Well-established, distinguished researchers in the humanities and social sciences employed at an eligible UK university (with research degree awarding powers)
opportunities.summary: Fellowships of 2-3 years for distinguished researchers in the humanities and social sciences to complete a piece of original research, funding replacement salary costs.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Senior researchers who have retired or partially retired from an academic post, live in the UK for a minimum of 26 weeks per year, and hold/have held a teaching and/or research post at a UK university or eligible independent research organisation
opportunities.summary: Fellowships of 3-24 months for retired or partially retired senior researchers to complete a research project and prepare results for publication. Application materials available from September 2026.

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers holding a post in a UK university with research degree awarding powers, resident in the UK at time of application, with an established track record
opportunities.summary: Fellowships of 3-24 months for experienced researchers in any discipline to complete a piece of research, providing replacement costs and research expenses. Application materials available from September 2026.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10 million over up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities registered by the Office for Students holding their own research degree awarding powers; previously excluded institutions (Oxford, Cambridge, Imperial) eligible in this round
opportunities.summary: The Leverhulme Centenary Research Centre round funds large-scale, outstanding original research aspiring to achieve a step-change in scholarship. Expected to open February 2027 for outline applications in June 2027.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards

amount.raw: Up to £1 million for staff salaries and associated costs

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career academics at UK universities with research degree awarding powers, with at least two years' post-PhD experience in a research/teaching post and holding (or nominated for) a permanent academic appointment at lecturer level or equivalent
opportunities.summary: The Centenary Research Leadership Awards support talented early career scholars to build a research team of sufficient scale (4-5 years) to tackle a distinctive research problem. Opens January 2028 for submission in May 2028.
